title: S0 request, several source images
$comment: Draft v1 (MS-1, designed, not yet implemented). Differs from request.v0 only in source_images (a list, in the order the caller means: index 1 is the first) replacing source_image; sending both is refused (additionalProperties). An edit needs at least one image, a generate takes none, an empty list is refused. The caps (edit.max_source_images, renderer.max_source_images, the backend image limit) are configuration values, so no maxItems is written here. request.v0 stays accepted for good.

prompt.description: Verbatim data, in any format or language (R-003).
